description: Yggdrasil addressing conformance corpus: the pinned upstream yggdrasil-go AddrForKey anchor (verbatim external oracle) plus profile-agnostic pubkey-length rejection cases. Per spec/decisions.jsonl upstream-yggdrasil-addressing, a LICHEN node's routable address MUST equal upstream AddrForKey(Ed25519PublicKey); this corpus is the independent conformance oracle for that requirement.

profiles.upstream_go_addr_for_key: Upstream yggdrasil-go algorithm: bit-invert the Ed25519 public key, count leading 1 bits into addr[1], drop the first 0 bit, then bit-pack the remainder into addr[2:16]. No hashing involved. This is the ONLY live address profile for LICHEN conformance.

rejected_profile_note: The former lichen_native_sha512 profile is REJECTED (spec/decisions.jsonl upstream-yggdrasil-addressing); its vectors are quarantined in test/vectors/legacy/yggdrasil_address_native_sha512.json and MUST NOT be used as conformance oracles. Existing implementations still derive the legacy profile — a known, tracked migration gap; tests consuming this corpus pin that divergence, not agreement.
